fix(codeon): isolate Named Pi runtime state directories

Named Pi profiles now require agent_dir_env and may set session_dir_env.
Typed PiStateAuthority injects PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR after bootstrap so two
Named keys cannot share ambient ~/.pi/agent while sealed evidence claims
distinct runtimes.
